title: Parent Criteria
description: Decomposition §4a. The frozen, structured list of parent criteria a work-breakdown must exactly partition. Main drafts; Codex EXPANDS any cross-cutting obligation into concrete per-child criteria (+ an integration/verifier criterion) then FREEZES via the freeze-wrapper. The binding hash lives in the wrapper-emitted criteria_frozen event, not here. Criterion-id uniqueness is enforced by decompose_check D2, not the schema.
